note: Shoshone NF (Greybull Ranger District) campground on the Wood River, 1 mile inside the forest boundary on FR 200: from Meeteetse, 7 miles west on WY 290, then 12.5 miles on the Wood River Road (County Road 4DT). Shaded sites with bear boxes. No garbage service: pack it out. The road on to the Kirwin ghost town, 18 miles west, is rough and the Forest Service recommends 4-wheel drive for it. --Claude
summary: FS page read (no rec.gov listing): 5 FCFS sites, 30-ft spurs, $10 cash/check, 16-day limit, vault toilets, no water (all manual; max_rig_ft 30 and max_stay 16 added). WATERFRONT: stored 'pond' is wrong - there is no pond (old evidence read a shadowed forested slope as water); the campground sits beside the narrow Wood River -> recommend creekside. Phone empty -> 307-527-6921. Pin fine. Unsourced 'rough but 2WD-passable' road line dropped from the note.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored 'pond', not --AWH): WRONG KIND - there is no pond or lake at this campground. The old evidence's 'still lily-pad pond/lake ~20-30m' is the steep north-facing conifer slope across the river, in deep shadow on the Esri image (tree crowns read as lily pads); the USGS Imagery Only layer (no shadow) shows forest there. The water is the Wood River, a narrow braided channel (wetted ~10-15 m, under the ~30 m riverfront line) with open gravel bars. The loop (centre ~43.9316,-109.1322) is on a grassy bench; its south-side sites (~43.93154,-109.1322) are ~20-35 m from the channel (~43.9313,-109.1322) over open grass and gravel bar, no road, trees or day use between. FS: 'five sites located along the beautiful Wood River'. Recommend pond -> creekside. Caveat: the FS publishes no site map, so the sites can't be numbered; if the reviewer requires numbered sites the fallback is not waterfront (there is no creek-view value).

ACCESS (not a drop): the FS 4-wheel-drive recommendation is for the road beyond the campground to Kirwin ('The ghost town of Kirwin is located 18 miles west (rough road - 4-wheel drive recommended)'), not for the 12.5-mile Wood River Road to the campground, which the FS page gives as the plain route. Kept in the note as a caveat. The old note's 'gravel and rough but 2WD-passable' had no agency source and was dropped.

SEASON: FS 'Operational Hours Typically from early/mid May through mid October' (and an odd 'Seasons of Use May of 2024' line); left unset (no exact dates). 'Site Closed - Closed for the season' is the ordinary end-of-season banner.
HORSE: FS activity list includes 'Horse Riding and Camping / Horseback Riding' but names no corrals, hitch rails or stock sites - an amenity line, not a horse camp (no flag).
PHONE: empty -> 307-527-6921 (Greybull Ranger District, FS page contact). Website https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/shoshone/recreation/wood-river-campground confirmed current. No recreation.gov listing.
